environment.build: release or rustc -O; see each experiment

baseline_source_binding.method: Retrospective full-tree source census, recovered original build invocation, and retained binary identity.
limits: The source census and file timestamp checks were collected retrospectively.
This binding relies on retained filesystem metadata and build artifacts.
It does not supply a contemporaneous build-time clean-tree log or a hermetic rebuild.

parser_cli.method: whole CLI, rotated stage order, warm/uncontrolled cache, wait4 CPU/RSS
limits: This parser-only build is not the final integrated build.
Whole CLI CPU and RSS come from wait4; RSS is not aggregate descendant peak.
Cache and host load are uncontrolled; observations do not establish a universal speedup.

parser-micro-base.normalization: visibility only; exact frozen function bodies

parser-micro-simd.normalization: visibility only; exact frozen function bodies

parser-micro-rbsp-fallback.normalization: visibility only; exact frozen function bodies

parser_micro.method: Five alternating observations per variant; 256 calls on a fixed 1 MiB synthetic input.
limits: Timed checksums aggregate output lengths; they are not full-byte output hashes.
Strict output/refusal equivalence is covered by separate differential regression tests.
Input construction, CLI I/O, and complete source admission are outside these loops.
Dense RBSP escaping has overlapping ranges and no meaningful speedup claim.

native_cipher_micro.normalization: None: complete git-show module bodies, including inactive tests
native_cipher_micro.measurement: Constructor, fixed-buffer copy, cipher calls and SHA-256 of every output byte; no CLI IO
native_cipher_micro.method: Three alternating pairs; at least 256 MiB per case, constructor/copy and full output SHA-256 included.
limits: Synthetic component loops, not complete CLI conversions.
CBC full-sample baseline is variable; do not infer a stable percentage from its median alone.
Sparse 1:9 and subsample patterns show no meaningful improvement.

hls_cipher_micro.normalization: Only fn visibility; original bodies and constants are unmodified
hls_cipher_micro.measurement: SAMPLE-AES constructor/copy/full output SHA; AES-128 constructor/cursor read/write/output reset/full output SHA
hls_cipher_micro.method: Three alternating pairs; at least 256 MiB per case with full output SHA-256.
limits: Synthetic component loops, not CLI or OS syscall measurements.
Read/write counts are Rust trait calls over in-memory cursors.
The small-resource path is unchanged; small differences do not prove a gain.
Patterned AVC and SAMPLE-AES ranges overlap; no general speedup is claimed.

reader_io.scope: Rust File::read/File::seek invocations from the owned PositionedInput wrapper; not OS syscalls
reader_io.coverage: 17 Reader instances in the same three existing independent oracle tests; includes fingerprints, metadata, EOF and media reads
limits: Counts are Rust File calls, not operating-system syscalls or whole CLI I/O.
Reader buffer reuse is separately tested; no global allocation-count claim is made.
These counts describe this measured revision; no I/O reduction is inferred from them.

overall_limits: Different experiments are not a smooth cumulative speedup curve.
Native and complete-decoding workloads provide different evidence and must be compared separately.
No other platform, DRM provider, license service or device playback qualification is inferred.

integrated_cli_matrix.method: serial, rotated binary/view/worker order, same view/compiler/depth/worker per comparison; warm/uncontrolled cache
integrated_cli_matrix.resource_semantics: wait4 direct child CPU/RSS; RSS is not aggregate process-tree peak; CLI scope sums overlap
integrated_cli_matrix.worker_semantics: Requested upper bounds, not observed concurrent worker counts.
